description: Record an agent test-writing attempt as static diagnostics. When test_path is provided for TS/JS, OrangePro first tries scoped deterministic re-prove; otherwise it re-analyzes the repo. Static hard COVERS edges render as Associated signal; public Proven requires orangepro_prove.

agent_pass.description: Whether the agent-reported test command passed. Advisory only.

evidence_ids.description: Generated-test/evidence ids tied to this attempt. Metadata only.

model.description: Model name used by the agent/generator, if any.

prompt_version.description: Prompt or workflow version used, if any.

provider.description: Model provider used by the agent/generator, if any.

run_id.description: Optional caller-supplied run id. Defaults to a local monotonic id.

source.description: Source checkout to re-analyze. Defaults to workspace.

target_id.description: Optional graph target id that must resolve to exactly one hard-linked CodeSymbol.

target_symbol.description: Exact CodeSymbol external id, e.g. sym:svc/add.go#Add. Preferred.

test_path.description: Workspace-relative test file the agent just wrote. Enables scoped deterministic re-prove for TS/JS.

vacuous.description: Whether the agent judged the test vacuous/non-assertive. Advisory only.

workspace.description: Local workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.

name: orangepro_record_run
title: Record gap-fill outcome
